feed.title: UK News - The latest headlines from the UK | Sky News

articles.title: PM open to 'honest discussion' about return to EU free movement
articles.summary: Andy Burnham says that an "honest discussion" is needed about readopting the EU's free movement rules.

articles.title: Labour unveils £285m funding boost to 'shift power' to local leaders
articles.summary: Andy Burnham has announced £285m to fund local communities, declaring mayors shouldn't have to go "cap in hand to Westminster".

articles.title: Police to allow some offenders to breach curfews without arrest
articles.summary: The Metropolitan Police is reducing enforcement of offenders who breach their tag conditions amid resourcing pressures and following early prisoner release.

articles.title: Man charged with murder after body found in wheelie bin
articles.summary: A man has been charged with murder after a body was found in a wheelie bin.

articles.title: British and French paratroopers take part in major wargame in Germany
articles.summary: Over 2,500 British and French troops have taken part in a wargame in Germany designed to show how NATO territory could be defended against an attack.

articles.title: Former Goldman Sachs chief leaves Britain amid tax hike fears
articles.summary: A former Goldman Sachs chief who sits on the board of Revolut, Europe's most valuable private technology company, has become the latest prominent financier to leave the country amid concerns about Britain’s rising tax burden.

articles.title: UK pledges £600m to defend against AI health and security threats
articles.summary: The UK has pledged to spend £600m to defend the public against threats to health and security from artificial intelligence.

articles.title: Why Trump told Burnham the UK is going to be 'very rich'
articles.summary: Donald Trump has said he told Andy Burnham the UK is set to become "a very rich country" after the prime minister decided to allow drilling in the North Sea.

articles.title: Vincent Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing at Bayern Munich training
articles.summary: Bayern Munich coach Vincent Kompany has been taken to hospital after collapsing at the club's training ground.

articles.title: Government backs bid for 'Northern Games' in 2040s
articles.summary: The prime minister is supporting plans to bring the Olympic and Paralympic Games back to the UK, with £7m cash due to be announced in next week's budget.
